name: Minister's Special Licence (MSL) Resident Draw Grants
summary: Alberta Conservation Association grants, funded by Government of Alberta special hunting licence draws, for projects that conserve and enhance wildlife populations and their habitat in Alberta. Organisations and individuals can lead.
reporting: A final report is due March 15 of the project year, with a signed financial statement.

eligibility.rule: Be a legally recognized organization or an individual, with liability insurance and WCB coverage
Lead is neither a federal/provincial ministry nor employee, and such employees do not run most of the project
Project activities occur between April 1, 2027 and March 31, 2028
Do not claim funding for work started before April 1, 2027
Grant cannot fund profit-making, overhead, emergency funds, deficit financing, general fundraising or land acquisition
Meet ACA’s Grounds for Disqualification policy

This Adjudication Committee will assess and rank the grant applications based on the established assessment criteria and funding priorities.

eligibility.quote: Any legally recognized organization (charity/society/corporation) or individual, with appropriate liability insurance and WCB coverage, can apply

MSLRDG does not fund applications where the federal or provincial government employee is the principal applicant (principal applicant is considered the lead on a project) or the principal applicant is a federal or provincial ministry. Federal or provincial government employees may be part of the project but must not be responsible for the majority of the project.
Project activities must occur between April 1, 2027, and March 31, 2028.
Grants cannot be made retrospectively, that is for work started prior to the current fiscal year (i.e., before April 1, 2027).
MSLRDG does not provide funding for: • • • • • • Projects outside of Alberta. Profit-making activities. Overhead costs. Emergency funds or deficit financing. General fundraising. Land acquisition.
Anyone engaged in the activities outlined in ACA’s “Grounds for Disqualification” will not be eligible to receive grant funds from ACA.

after_award.quote: Provide a progress report to ACA by September 1, 2027. The progress report should be in ACA’s template, which can be found on ACA’s website www.ab-conservation.com b. Provide a final report to ACA by March 15, 2028.
